The columns include: "tallangatta dfl" (team names), "wins" (number of matches won), "byes" (number of rounds without a match, all zero for every team), "losses" (number of matches lost), "draws" (number of drawn matches, all zero), and "against" (total points conceded by each team during the season). The data reveals a clear hierarchy: Kiewa Sandy Creek and Tallangatta Valley dominate the league with 16 wins each, followed by Beechworth (15) and Yackandandah (13). At the bottom, Wodonga Saints and Chiltern struggled with only 1 win and 17 losses each. A notable pattern is that the "against" column generally increases as team performance declines — top teams concede around 1,013–1,165 points, while bottom teams concede over 2,250–2,535 points, indicating that weaker teams not only lose more often but also suffer heavier defeats. Additionally, every team has zero byes and zero draws, suggesting a clean, evenly scheduled season with no tied results.
